description: CodeVow — plan-first collaboration, TDD, evidence-driven debugging, review and verification

defaultPrompt: Use the workflow skill: classify this request, confirm scope and applicable authorization, then organize the work
interface.longDescription: CodeVow provides six AI coding skills for planning, TDD, evidence-driven debugging, risk-focused review, final-state verification and readable review results. Two collaboration policies preserve user authorization. Optional local Python tools resolve policies, maintain workspace-bound task/evidence records and stage owned files with receipts. It has no MCP server, background service or autonomous Git publishing. Native host behavior remains unverified.
